text:
It is forbidden

for hunger to eat

for the mouth to speak

for the ear to hear

for thirst to drink

for fire to warm

for fear to run

for cold to shiver

for joy to laugh

for love to love

for the poet to sing

for the wounded to moan

for spring to bloom

for gunpowder to explode.


Afterward

they shot them for not complying.


THE END




Chile, 1973

translation.title: Decrees
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the authoritarian proclamation pattern and the absurdity of punishing natural forces for disobedience.
